mapper.sql: select toutdeliverysamllrecord.id, toutdeliverysamllrecord.out_delivery_detail_id, toutdeliverysamllrecord.material_detail_id, toutdeliverysamllrecord.location_id, toutdeliverysamllrecord.tray_id, toutdeliverysamllrecord.remark, toutdeliverysamllrecord.create_by, toutdeliverysamllrecord.create_time, toutdeliverysamllrecord.update_by, toutdeliverysamllrecord.update_time, toutdeliverysamllrecord.dept_id, toutdeliverysamllrecord.dept_name, toutdeliverysamllrecord.del_flag from t_out_delivery_samll_record toutdeliverysamllrecord
mapper.select:
SELECT toutdeliverysamllrecord.* ,b.material_code,b.material_name ,d.`name` unit_name , e.name location_name , f.`name` reservoir_name ,h.small_receive_count ,i.code tray_code ,g.`name` as areaName FROM t_out_delivery_samll_record toutdeliverysamllrecord left JOIN t_material_detail b on toutdeliverysamllrecord.material_detail_id = b.id join t_material c on b.material_id = c.id left join t_unit_config uc on c.id = uc.material_id LEFT JOIN t_unit d ON uc.min_unit_id = d.id left join t_location e on toutdeliverysamllrecord.location_id = e.id left join t_reservoir f on e.reservoir_id = f.id left join t_area g on e.area_id = g.id left join t_out_delivery_detail h on toutdeliverysamllrecord.out_delivery_detail_id = h.id left join t_tray i on toutdeliverysamllrecord.tray_id = i.id
inner join sys_user u on u.user_name = toutdeliverysamllrecord.create_by and u.status = '0' inner join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id and d.status = '0'
toutdeliverysamllrecord.del_flag = '0' and c.name like "%" #{materialName} "%" and c.code like "%" #{materialCode} "%" and i.code like "%" #{trayCode} "%"
${params.dataScope}
mapper.delete: update t_out_delivery_samll_record set del_flag = '1' where id = #{id}
